name: ld_agent
description: LD-Agent (Li et al., NAACL 2025): model-agnostic long-term dialogue agent -- event memory (per-session LLM summaries keyed by spaCy noun topics, retrieved by noun overlap x time decay), turn-by-turn user/agent persona extraction, and a role-play response generator. Prompts and scoring vendored verbatim from the MIT-licensed repo; LLM calls through llm.complete(), so any --model works (default local gemma). For msc_longterm / conversation_chronicles. Needs the ld_agent extra (spaCy en_core_web_sm).
author: Wnsdnl
